item.title: Suno Launches Visuals Feature for AI Music Video Generation
item.description:
Suno Launches Visuals Feature for AI Music Video Generation

Suno has introduced image and video generation capabilities in its latest effort to expand beyond its role as an AI music platform. The new feature, named “Visuals,” allows users to transform Suno songs into AI-generated video clips that automatically lipsync to lyrics, or create images via prompt descriptions that can serve as thumbnails and album artwork.

🧩 How it works

The Visuals feature generates images and 15-second videos that automatically sync with Suno songs. From the interface, users can select which section of the track to use, up to a maximum of 15 seconds, and select a reference image to build the generated video clip.

There are three options available for the starting image reference:

  • Selecting one of the original character presets provided by Suno.
  • Uploading a user’s own photo or artwork.
  • Generating the image directly on Suno using descriptive prompts.

For video generation, users can select whether the reference image is used as the start or end frame, making it easier to edit the 15-second clips together. There is a toggle to automatically lipsync vocals to the generated video, along with tools for adjusting aspect ratio and clip length. The image generation capabilities also allow users to select specific aspect ratios, optimizing results for landscape or portrait modes and online platforms.

⚙️ Key details

Visuals includes a dedicated video editing timeline for assembling clips into longer videos and adding customizable song lyric text. The H3 Move AI model, based on H3 from MiniMax, powers this feature.

Suno states that the AI has been “optimized for our community including adding additional protections and safeguards,” which include a “suite of new text and visual filters” designed to block the use or generation of the likeness of specific artists, public figures, copyrighted works, and IP.

The feature uses its own “Visuals credits” to generate videos and images. These credits are distinct from the song credits used to make AI music, meaning users will have additional expenses to pay in order to use this new feature.

🚀 Availability

Visuals is available on web, iOS, and Android platforms. The exact layout differs across Suno’s desktop and mobile interfaces, but users will find a new Visuals tab under Create mode on each version. Web users can also access Visuals by selecting the three-dot menu on a song in their library.

💡 Context and reception

The launch of Visuals follows Suno introducing a Speech feature in October for generating spoken words and voiceovers. In the YouTube video for the Visuals launch, one user commented “FIX AUDIO BEFORE ADDING CRAP NOBODY ASKED FOR,” a sentiment that other commenters are echoing.

#Suno #AImusic #AImusicvideos #Imagegeneration

Source: Suno now lets you make AI videos for your AI music

item.title: Pagekin: Open-source AI novel writing app
item.description:
Pagekin: Open-source AI novel writing app

Pagekin, formerly AI Novel Writer, is a free, open-source AI novel writing app designed for long novels and web fiction. It is local-first, with no model bundled, and available for Windows and macOS. Maintained by EthanYoQ, Pagekin allows users to write and manage their works locally on their own computers.

🔍 Overview

  • Free, open-source AI novel writing app
  • Designed for long novels and web fiction
  • Local-first, no model bundled
  • Available for Windows and macOS
  • Maintained by EthanYoQ

🧩 How it works

  • Works exist on your own computer
  • Software does not bundle models; users can connect their own API Key or use Ollama to run local models
  • Supports importing novels in .txt, .md, or .epub formats
  • Architecture page is divided into four sections: story premise, character list, world view, and plot outline
  • Each character has basic settings, current status, and relationship map
  • Character cards can be pasted or imported from files
  • Blueprint page lists planned chapters
  • Batch creation allows writing up to 10 chapters at a time
  • AI uses the chapter’s blueprint, relevant characters, world view, summary of previous text, and the full text of the previous chapter
  • Text editor supports inserting two full-width spaces as paragraph indentation
  • All generation tasks are managed in the running side page, divided into ongoing, history, and diagnostic pages
  • Tracks main plot, subplots, and foreshadowing by chapter
  • Knowledge base can be imported with reference materials in .txt or .md formats
  • Export options include merged Markdown, chaptered Markdown, or TXT
  • Works can be saved locally or backed up to a WebDAV cloud service
  • Writing skills can be selected from a local folder or single SKILL.md file, or from a GitHub address
  • Available in light and dark themes
  • Supports Chinese and English interfaces
  • Supports OpenAI compatible and Gemini native protocols
  • Built-in presets for various service providers: DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, BigModel, OpenAI, xAI, Google Gemini, Ollama, NovelAI, and custom
  • Semantic search in the knowledge base requires a separate vector model, configurable in the retrieval model settings
  • Upgrades only update the application itself, preserving works, character cards, and settings
  • Supports arm64 for Apple Silicon Macs (M1, M2, M3, M4, etc.)

🚀 Availability

  • Free, open-source
  • Windows & macOS
  • Supports arm64 for Apple Silicon Macs

💡 Why it matters

  • Provides a local-first approach to AI novel writing
  • Offers flexibility in model usage and integration
  • Supports multiple export and backup options
  • Allows for detailed character and plot management
  • Supports multiple languages and themes
  • Offers a range of service provider presets
  • Ensures data privacy by keeping works and settings local
  • Preserves user data during upgrades

#AIWriting #OpenSource #NovelWriting #AITools #WebFiction

Source: EthanYoQ/Pagekin

item.title: Apple adds $49.99 Intelligence Usage Packs to Logic Pro
item.description:
Apple adds $49.99 Intelligence Usage Packs to Logic Pro

Apple has introduced a one‑time $49.99 “Intelligence Usage Pack” for Logic Pro, letting users extend access to cloud‑based AI features that have usage limits.

🔍 Overview

  • Logic Pro includes a built‑in AI assistant that can start a new song, set up a vocal track from a single prompt, or refine an active project.
  • Some Apple Intelligence features rely on cloud models from OpenAI or Google Gemini and therefore have usage limits.

🧩 How it works

  • Users can purchase an Intelligence Usage Pack for $49.99 via Intelligence Features > Show Usage in the app’s main menu.
  • The pack applies only to the Apple Account that bought it; Family Sharing is not supported.
  • Any unused usage rolls over month to month but expires 12 months after purchase.
  • For Logic Pro, the usage limit is “impacted by the complexity of conversations you have with the assistant.”

⚙️ Key details

  • Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to the limited AI features.
  • Logic Pro is Apple’s first app to charge for extended usage of Apple Intelligence.
  • The pack is a one‑time purchase of $49.99.

🚀 Availability

  • Currently, only Logic Pro offers the option to buy more usage.
  • Apple expects to add the same option to other Creator Studio apps this month, including Pixelmator Pro, Final Cut Pro, Motion, Pages, Keynote, and Numbers, which are receiving access to Apple’s AI chatbot.

💡 Why it matters

  • The pack lets users continue using AI features after the free quota is exhausted.
  • Introducing a paid usage model marks Apple’s first monetization of extended Apple Intelligence usage within its software suite.
  • The rollout to additional creator apps suggests broader adoption of paid AI usage across Apple’s productivity ecosystem.

#AppleIntelligence #LogicPro #AIUsagePacks #MusicAI #CreatorStudio

Source: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features

item.title: Dreamina Introduces Seedance 2.5 for Multimodal Video Generation
item.description:
Dreamina Introduces Seedance 2.5 for Multimodal Video Generation

🔍 Overview

Dreamina is positioned as the first pick for creators who want to develop a visual idea and turn it into a video through prompts and references. The new Seedance 2.5 route expands that capability by bringing audio and multiple reference types into the brief.

🧩 How it works

Dreamina’s Seedance 2.5 guide describes a multimodal route:

  • Images can establish appearance.
  • Video can communicate movement.
  • Audio can help direct the sound or performance.

The workflow makes particular sense when you have a visual idea but not yet a finished starting frame. For example, a product reveal may need a particular object, a restrained camera move, and a sound timed to the reveal. In that scenario, a source image settles the composition, a motion reference communicates pacing, and an audio brief identifies what the audience should hear.

⚙️ Capabilities

  • Turn a visual idea into a video through prompts and references.
  • Seedance 2.5 adds native audio and supports multiple reference types.
  • Handles scenarios such as social campaigns, music visuals, or short stories that need characters and settings established before movement is added.
  • Example (Seedance 2.0 Mini): a still photograph and a five‑second setting produce successive frames with changing clouds, reflections, and light while the shoreline, grass, and fence remain recognizable.
  • Light changes across frames; a brief requiring fixed illumination would need a different result.
  • The Mini example does not demonstrate Seedance 2.5 audio or motion continuity.

📊 Comparison with other tools

Tool Notable Feature
Dreamina Multimodal reference‑guided video generation (Seedance 2.5)
Google Veo Strong alternative for audiovisual scene generation; supports native audio; documented approaches to references, scene continuity, and camera direction
Runway Considered for deliberate shot development
Kling Offers more control over reference assets and story beats
Adobe Firefly Supports an Adobe‑centered creative workflow
Luma Helps teams evaluate generation and video editing together
Hailuo with MiniMax H3 Provides multimodal references and native audio

💰 Cost considerations

  • Consult Dreamina’s pricing alongside the cost shown for the selected operation.
  • A free completion under one account offer does not establish the future cost of every model.
  • Reference‑guided animation still reconstructs the scene, so an instruction to preserve a package or face needs visual review.

📅 Availability

Product information was checked October 9–10, 2026.

The comparison covers documented creative controls, access and project fit, with a Dreamina image‑animation example referenced above.

#Dreamina #AIAnimation #MultimodalAI #VideoGeneration

Source: 7 AI Video Generators for Your Next Creative Project

item.title: Beyond Flat Images: Mastering Hi3DGen for Photorealistic 3D Model Creation
item.description:
🌟 Beyond Flat Images: Mastering Hi3DGen for Photorealistic 3D Model Creation

Summary: Discover how Hi3DGen is revolutionizing 3D content creation through AI-powered technology. This guide explores its unmatched capabilities for generating photorealistic 3D models from simple text prompts, making professional-grade 3D creation accessible to everyone regardless of technical expertise.

🚀 The 3D Revolution at Your Fingertips

In the rapidly evolving landscape of AI-powered creative tools, Hi3DGen stands out as a game-changer for 3D content creation. Gone are the days when creating photorealistic 3D models required extensive technical expertise and expensive software. Today, we’re witnessing a democratization of 3D creation capabilities that puts professional-grade tools in everyone’s hands.

Hi3DGen represents the cutting edge of this revolution—transforming simple text descriptions into stunning, detailed 3D models with remarkable accuracy. Whether you’re a game developer, product designer, content creator, or just curious about 3D modeling, Hi3DGen offers an accessible entry point into the world of three-dimensional digital creation.

🔍 What Makes Hi3DGen Special?

Hi3DGen isn’t just another 3D generator—it’s a comprehensive ecosystem designed to make high-quality 3D content creation accessible to everyone. Here’s what sets it apart:

𝗧𝗲𝘅𝘁-𝘁𝗼-𝟯𝗗 𝗖𝗮𝗽𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀

Unlike traditional modeling tools that require extensive manual input, Hi3DGen can interpret natural language descriptions and transform them into detailed 3D models. Want a “rustic wooden table with metal accents and a weathered finish”? Simply type it in, and watch as the AI interprets your vision with surprising accuracy.

𝙎𝙪𝙥𝙚𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙧 𝙏𝙚𝙭𝙩𝙪𝙧𝙚 𝙌𝙪𝙖𝙡𝙞𝙩𝙮

One of the most impressive aspects of Hi3DGen is its ability to generate not just geometrically accurate models but also photorealistic textures. The system understands material properties and lighting interactions, creating surfaces that look and respond to light like their real-world counterparts. 🌈

𝘗𝘩𝘺𝘴𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺 𝘈𝘤𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘦 𝘔𝘰𝘥𝘦𝘭𝘴

The platform doesn’t just create visually appealing models—it creates structurally sound ones. This means objects generated through Hi3DGen can potentially be used for simulations, game physics, or even manufacturing applications without extensive reworking.

🛠️ Getting Started with Hi3DGen

Setting up Hi3DGen is surprisingly straightforward, making it accessible even to those with minimal technical background:

  1. Access the Platform 🔑 Visit the official interface through Hugging Face or other supported platforms. The web-based interface eliminates the need for heavy software installation.

  2. Craft Your Prompt ✨ The magic begins with your description. Be specific and detailed about what you want to create. For example, instead of “a chair,” try “a mid-century modern armchair with walnut frame and cream upholstery.”

  3. Fine-tune Parameters 🎛️ Hi3DGen allows you to adjust various generation parameters:

    • Resolution quality (higher for more detail)
    • Generation steps (more steps = more refined results)
    • Style guidance (how closely to follow artistic references)

  4. Export & Use 📤 Once generated, your 3D models can be exported in standard formats compatible with major 3D software including Blender, Maya, and Unity. This seamless workflow integration makes Hi3DGen particularly valuable for professional pipelines.

💡 Practical Applications & Use Cases

The versatility of Hi3DGen makes it valuable across numerous fields:

𝗚𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 🎮

Indie developers can rapidly prototype environments and objects without dedicated 3D artists. A game developer could generate an entire medieval village’s worth of props in hours rather than weeks.

𝙋𝙧𝙤𝙙𝙪𝙘𝙩 𝙑𝙞𝙨𝙪𝙖𝙡𝙞𝙯𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣 📱

Product designers can quickly visualize concepts and iterations without waiting for physical prototypes. Imagine generating dozens of variations for a new chair design in minutes rather than days.

𝑉𝑖𝑟𝑡𝑢𝑎𝑙 𝑃𝑟𝑜𝑑𝑢𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 🎬

Film and animation studios can use Hi3DGen to create background assets and props that would otherwise require significant modeling resources. This democratizes high-quality production capabilities for smaller studios.

𝘈𝘳𝘤𝘩𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘢𝘭 𝘝𝘪𝘴𝘶𝘢𝘭𝘪𝘻𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯 🏙️

Architects can rapidly generate furniture, decorative elements, and even structural components to populate their digital mock-ups with realistic details.

🔮 The Future of AI-Generated 3D Content

As technologies like Hi3DGen continue to evolve, we’re witnessing just the beginning of a profound transformation in how digital 3D content is created. The implications are far-reaching:

  • Democratized Creation: Complex 3D modeling is no longer restricted to those with years of technical training
  • Accelerated Workflows: Tasks that once took days can now be completed in minutes
  • Creative Exploration: Designers can explore more iterations and concepts in less time
  • Industry Disruption: Traditional 3D modeling workflows may need to evolve as AI-generated content becomes more prevalent

Looking ahead, we can expect these tools to become even more sophisticated, with improvements in physical accuracy, animation capabilities, and integration with other creative workflows. The boundary between imagination and digital realization continues to blur at an astonishing pace.

🤔 Final Thoughts

Hi3DGen represents a fascinating intersection of artificial intelligence, computer graphics, and creative tools. While it won’t replace human creativity and artistic judgment, it dramatically lowers the technical barriers to bringing 3D ideas to life.

As with any powerful creative technology, the most exciting applications will come from how creators combine these new capabilities with their unique vision and expertise. What could you create if technical limitations were removed from your creative process?
